doc.title: Jane Jarvis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe thanks her, mentions her upcoming gig and November birthday celebration, and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Great. Well thanks so much for being with us today.
Well it’s been a joy and I’m very proud to be with you.

On behalf of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive we’d like to thank Jane Jarvis, pianist, arranger, composer, ballpark entertainer, and on and on, and it’s been a great pleasure. And I hope your gig goes well tonight. And I hope we see you in November and I hope that’s a great birthday bash for you.
Oh, I’m going to take roll call. You’d better be there.
